name: Duck
description: Pseudonym of one of the two artificers who founded the Conclave.

description_citations.text: "Conclave of Mages". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nod and Duck found the Conclave on the ruins of the Monastery of Gix, and Jarsyl soon joins.
timeline.quote: The Conclave was a school that was founded between 69 and 80 AR by " Nod " and " Duck " to study both artifice and magic.

citation.text: "Conclave of Mages", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jarsyl tells Kayla he cannot go with her because he wants to join a school of magic and artifice run by Nod and Duck, and Kayla blesses it.
timeline.quote: Go north. If there are teachers greater than me, seek them out.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
